title: Prescriptive Business Rules
purpose: Translate BA-12 risk scores into human-supervised maintenance and operational recommendations.
decision_principles: Risk ranking is a decision-support input, not an autonomous control command.
All recommendations require human review and approval before execution.
Recommendations should be checked against current alarms, asset condition, maintenance history, operational context, and safety procedures.
Production thresholds, escalation paths, and planning windows must be recalibrated with governed CGSL data and actual business costs.

rules.Operational_Response: Escalate to responsible maintenance/operations lead; validate condition and arrange immediate inspection.
rules.Planning_Response: Create or prioritize a maintenance work item after human validation; consider restricting non-essential use only when separately authorized.
rules.Evidence_To_Check: Recent alarms/alerts, operating condition indicators, maintenance history, outstanding defects, recent abnormal events.

rules.Prescriptive_Action: Prioritize technical review and planned inspection
rules.Operational_Response: Escalate for technical review and verify whether inspection or maintenance can be brought forward.
rules.Planning_Response: Schedule inspection or planned maintenance within the approved maintenance planning window, subject to human review.
rules.Evidence_To_Check: Recent trend/condition indicators, maintenance history, recurring defects, operating context.

rules.Operational_Response: Maintain routine operational monitoring and normal escalation processes.
rules.Planning_Response: Keep routine inspection/maintenance cadence unless other evidence indicates a change in condition.
rules.Evidence_To_Check: Routine condition indicators, recent maintenance history, newly reported defects or alarms.
